title: Advisor Profile (portable persona pack)
description: A portable, workspace-independent distillation of how a person thinks, decides, and argues — forged in one Command Room and seatable as a 'persona' board member in another. MUST be free of workspace-local internal IDs (no person_NNN / project_NNN / org_NNN / event seqs): the pack travels between workspaces where those IDs are meaningless and would leak source-workspace structure. Stored locally at `_hq/data/advisors/<slug>.json` (imported or modeled) and exported (self-fidelity only) as `_hq/advisors/exported/AdvisorProfile_<Name>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.json`.

display_name.description: Human name as it should appear at the board table (e.g., 'Sam Sample'). NOT an internal ID.

role.description: Functional role/title as a human string (e.g., 'Co-founder & CFO'). No org IDs.

org_label.description: Human org label (e.g., 'Acme Co'). Free string, never an org_NNN id.

headline.description: One line: who this person is at the table and the lens they bring.

mandate_default.description: What this seat naturally optimizes for — the question they always come back to (e.g., 'Can we afford it, and what does it do to cash?').

decision_heuristics.description: How they decide — the rules of thumb they apply ('always wants unit economics before vision').

priorities.description: What they weight heavily when judging a plan.

risk_posture.description: Their stance toward risk, in their own shape (e.g., 'aggressive on growth, conservative on cash').

known_positions.description: Stated positions on recurring topics. Topic + position as human strings; no source-event IDs.

pushback_patterns.description: What they reliably challenge or refuse to let slide.

communication_style.description: How they argue and what convinces them (cadence, directness, evidence they respect). Voice of reasoning, not a writing-voice clone.

blind_spots.description: Where this lens is weak — what they systematically underweight. Surfaced honestly so a board doesn't over-trust one seat.

fidelity.description: 'self' = forged by the person themselves from their own rich substrate (high fidelity, shareable). 'observed' = modeled by another operator from their own notes/transcripts of this person (lower fidelity, NEVER shareable out).

shareable.description: Whether this pack may be written to an exportable file. MUST be false when fidelity == 'observed'. The writer refuses to export a non-shareable pack.

forged_by_label.description: Human label of who forged it (e.g., the operator's first name or brain name). NEVER an email or internal ID.

source_signal_summary.description: Counts only, no content: e.g., '14 logged decisions, 9 1:1 transcripts, voice profile'. Lets an importer judge fidelity without leaking source material.

forged_on.description: ISO date (no time) the pack was forged.

workspace_origin_label.description: Optional human label of the originating workspace (e.g., "Sam Sample's Command Room"). Free string, no machine identifiers.
